items.title: Anthropic and OpenAI are joining the AI stage at TechCrunch Disrupt 2026
items.summary: At TechCrunch Disrupt 2026, the AI Stage is back to dig into the single hottest topic in the community for the past few years, presented by Google for Startups.
items.author: TechCrunch Events

items.title: Barret Zoph, the Thinking Machines co-founder ousted before joining OpenAI, is now at Google
items.summary: Zoph, who co-founded Thinking Machines Lab alongside Mira Murati and also served as the startup's CTO, led a brief stint at OpenAI and is now at Google.
items.author: Lucas Ropek

items.title: OpenAI, Anthropic, Google, and 100 other companies call for action to defend against rogue AI
items.summary: Some of the world's largest tech companies and AI startups have come together to decry the current state of cybersecurity and to advertise a new solution that they say can ward off a new generation of cyber threats.
items.author: Lucas Ropek

items.title: Google’s AI Mode can now track flight prices, help book hotels, and more
items.summary: The updates indicate that Google is looking to position AI Mode as an AI travel agent of sorts, as it's moving beyond simply helping users find information to actually handling parts of the trip-planning and booking process.
items.author: Aisha Malik

items.title: Hugging Face is selling a cute $399 open source duck robot, Microduck
items.summary: Clem Delangue, CEO of Hugging Face, said the Microduck is an “open-source robot you can teach new tricks with reinforcement learning.”
items.author: Rebecca Bellan

items.title: AI’s memory crunch is coming for Android apps
items.summary: Google is setting new memory-use limits for Android apps as AI data centers contribute to hardware shortages that could leave lower-cost phones with less memory.
items.author: Sarah Perez

items.title: Here’s all the times AI has gone rogue and hacked other companies
items.summary: A recap of all the incidents involving LLMs made by Anthropic, Meta, and OpenAI, which went rogue and attacked real companies and individuals on the internet.
items.author: Lorenzo Franceschi-Bicchierai

items.title: Plaud’s new earphones come with an eSIM-enabled case for talking to AI agents
items.summary: Called Plaud One, these adopt the simple bare-bones style of Apple's AirPods, and can record calls, while their case can be used to record in-person conversations or take notes.
items.author: Ivan Mehta

items.title: OpenAI to start showing ads on ChatGPT’s free and Go tiers in India
items.summary: OpenAI has more than 100 million weekly active ChatGPT users in India, a huge chunk of whom are on the free or the lower-priced Go tiers.
items.author: Ivan Mehta

items.title: Nvidia closes in on Hugging Face acquisition
items.summary: Nvidia has reportedly agreed to buy Hugging Face, the popular open source AI hub, for $12.9 billion in a move that would let Nvidia both protect its chip empire and jump back into the cloud business.
items.author: Connie Loizos
